canonical_concepts.label: reproduction
definitions: essential for the continuation of a species

canonical_concepts.label: sexual reproduction
definitions: reproduction beginning from the fusion of male and female gametes

canonical_concepts.label: zygote
definitions: the beginning of a new individual
a fertilised egg
The structure formed after fertilisation that begins to develop into an embryo.
The cell formed after fertilization that divides repeatedly and travels down the oviduct.

canonical_concepts.label: sperm
definitions: a single cell with all the usual cell components

canonical_concepts.label: ovaries
definitions: The ovary produces female gametes called ova (eggs).

canonical_concepts.label: uterus
definitions: Uterus is the part where development of the baby takes place.

canonical_concepts.label: Fertilisation
definitions: the fusion of the egg and the sperm
The process of fertilisation is the meeting of an egg cell from the mother and a sperm cell from the father.

canonical_concepts.label: Internal fertilisation
definitions: Fertilisation which takes place inside the female body is called internal fertilisation.

canonical_concepts.label: frog's eggs
definitions: Not covered by a shell and comparatively very delicate.

canonical_concepts.label: external fertilisation
definitions: The type of fertilisation in which the fusion of a male and a female gamete takes place outside the body of the female.

canonical_concepts.label: Embryo
definitions: The developing structure formed from the zygote that eventually develops into different tissues and organs.

canonical_concepts.label: Foetus
definitions: The stage of the embryo in which all the body parts can be identified.

canonical_concepts.label: Viviparous animals
definitions: Animals which give birth to young ones.
The animals which give birth to young ones.

canonical_concepts.label: Oviparous animals
definitions: Animals which lay eggs that later develop into young ones.
Those animals which lay eggs.

canonical_concepts.label: metamorphosis
definitions: The transformation of the larva into an adult through drastic changes.
